purpose: Optional video tooling inventory; NOT installed packages or verified integrations

tools.name: FFmpeg / FFprobe
tools.role: Current local cutting, verification, captions, audio and MP4 output
tools.note: FFprobe is separately checked by the existing doctor; retain the current pipeline.

tools.name: Faster Whisper
tools.note: Model weights download on first use; verify model license and transcript accuracy.

tools.name: FFmpeg Skill
tools.note: Overlaps with existing FFmpeg scripts; enable only for tasks needing its typed tools.

tools.name: Auto-Editor
tools.note: Preview all proposed cuts; do not override human-approved work/edl.json.

tools.name: Claude Shorts
tools.role: Optional Claude-led moment selection, tracking and Remotion captions
tools.note: Requires Claude Code, Node, Python and FFmpeg; Windows uses WSL2. No independent production quality guarantee.

tools.name: Ghost Editor
tools.role: Optional talking-head and explainer preset workflow
tools.note: Apple Silicon Mac + paid Claude Code plan; optional Gemini/ElevenLabs steps can send data or charge: disable unless authorized.

tools.name: OpenMontage
tools.role: Optional agentic video-production pipelines and free footage workflow
tools.note: AGPL obligations may apply; many demos use billable model providers. Keep external provider paths disabled.

tools.name: rea-video
tools.role: Analyze reference videos; output report.html and VIDEO.md
tools.note: Analysis is not rendering; video-capable cloud models and remake generation can incur costs.

tools.name: HyperFrames
tools.role: Optional HTML-native motion graphics and local MP4 renderer
tools.note: Local CLI/Studio free; Pro-only reverse-any-video and style-sampling, HeyGen generation and cloud render are blocked.

tools.name: Remotion
tools.note: Not generally unrestricted OSS. Check current license and commercial eligibility before use; choose HyperFrames OR Remotion.

tools.name: Piper TTS (rhasspy archive)
tools.role: Offline voice synthesis for faceless video
tools.note: This repository is archived. Pick a maintained distribution; voice-model licenses and pronunciation vary.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.note: High VRAM/storage may be required; model weights may have separate licenses. No cloud GPU by default.

tools.name: Lemo-Opuscar
tools.license: MIT (code); CC BY-NC 4.0 (docs); third-party asset terms vary
tools.role: Optional code-generated style and motion components within Workbench video projects
tools.note: Workbench now embeds separately produced Lemo video clips as reviewed native segments in scripts/produce.py. Local style listing/planning is implemented; upstream code-based film generation still requires separate toolchain and license checks. Docs CC BY-NC 4.0; no auto-download or paid API calls.

tools.name: Higgsfield AI Skills / Editorial Motion Graphics
tools.role: Optional external generation skills, not part of zero-extra-cost path
tools.note: Skill code is free but hosted Higgsfield models can consume credits. Never auto-authenticate or submit jobs.

long-to-shorts.action: Use owned/authorized local media in project/src; check rights and platform policies.
Run existing transcribe.py and low_token.py; verify text and boundaries.
Optional: score hooks with an existing agent session; otherwise manually select from compact transcript packet.

For requested code-generated title/intro/visual scene only, browse local Lemo styles; after separate licensed generation, add a matching Lemo handoff as a native produce.py visual_component segment and review the preview before final.
Existing FFmpeg preview and short preset first; use exactly one optional renderer for advanced typography.

faceless.action: Optional local workflow planning; use rights-cleared stock, original media or assets only.

Discover selected Lemo styles locally; create film-style plans when helpful. An independently generated, rights-cleared clip can become a native produce.py visual_component segment using a matching review handoff. This does not auto-run the Lemo renderer.
Use local Piper voice where licensed; ComfyUI only if hardware and model licenses permit.
Optional VIDEO.md/style analysis; do not reuse unlicensed frames/audio.
FFmpeg or one approved local renderer; do not call Higgsfield/HeyGen paid generation.

own-footage.action: Use existing editorial intake and preserve original source.
Existing cuts.py first. Auto-Editor or Ghost Editor only if needed and compatible.
Analyze reference editing techniques without copying third-party content.

For requested code-generated title/intro/visual scene only, browse local Lemo styles; after separate licensed generation, add a matching Lemo handoff as a native produce.py visual_component segment and review the preview before final.
Use established EDL; try one optional graphics tool; keep approved export.
